content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Training and Placement Officer: Two-year PG Degree in Management (MBA) or PG Diploma (PGDM/PGDBM) in Human Resources or related disciplines such as Marketing, HRM, Corporate Communication, etc. Experience: At least 3 years of working experience in the Training & Placement Cell of a reputed Academic Institution (Desirable).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIIT Bhopal Training and Placement Officer Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 20-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Information Technology Bhopal (IIIT Bhopal) for filling up contractual positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Training and Placement Officer on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Training and Placement Officer position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a two-year PG Degree in Management (MBA) or PG Diploma (PGDM/PGDBM) in Human Resources or related disciplines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 45 years as on 20th October 2026, with age relaxations as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging between ₹ 80,000 and ₹ 1,00,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application through email and speed post is 20th October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply by sending their duly filled application form via email followed by a hard copy via Speed Post.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: General and OBC candidates are required to pay an application fee of ₹ 500/-, while SC, ST, PwBD, ESM, and women candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes shortlisting based on qualifications and experience, followed by a test and/or personal interview.
